On this episode of Limbach Unlocked and Ahead of the Moment, we explore what it really means to keep data centers operating reliably. Listen in as host James Swanson joins Ryan Larkin (National Account Executive), and John Perry (Fabrication Project Manager) to deliver a behind-the-scenes look at what goes into Limbach’s mission to drive innovation and operational excellence in building systems.


Ryan leads the episode by sharing several risk factors that can lead to facility downtime and what it can mean for building owners (4:51). Why are traditional cooling methods no longer enough? Listen in as Ryan explains how Data Centers and AI are elevating the demand for innovation (6:39). When should owners consider rental cooling vs. permanent upgrades (8:01)?


John joins the conversation to share insight into how prefabrication is reshaping speed, consistency, and execution (9:09). Listen as John explains how prefabrication is helping to mitigate safety risks and improve coordination (11:28).


Ryan closes us out by discussing how Limbach bridges the gap between construction and ongoing maintenance. What kind of evolving cooling technologies are being utilized (13:29), and how are they combating heavy AI data workloads (15:29)? What other cooling solutions does Limbach offer (16:15)?
